body.title: Tool-surface under-read is invisible on repos that do not use a tools/ directory: 4 of 125 tools published as a complete count
body.body:
## What happens

`github/github-mcp-server` — the repo used as the headline example in README.md:7 and as the
sample `--json` scorecard at README.md:131-134 — is published with **`toolCount: 4`**.

The repo actually defines **125 distinct tool names**, 34 of them write or delete verbs
(`delete_file`, `push_files`, `merge_pull_request`, `create_or_update_file`,
`create_repository`, `fork_repository`, …).

The four that were read are `ui_get`, `get_me`, `get_teams`, `get_team_members` — all
read-only, all from a 13-file sample. Everything downstream then treats that sample as the
whole surface:

| field | published | reality |
|---|---|---|
| `toolCount` | 4 | 125 |
| `toolSurfaceRisk` | `low` | 34 destructive verbs |
| cost | 100/100 (the ≤10-tools band) | not measurable from 4 of 125 |
| security | 85/100 (primary, weight 3 of 6) | built on the wrong risk |
| overall | **96/100 A+** | — |
| `errors` | `[]` | — |
| partial-read note | none | — |

There is no signal anywhere on the card that the read was partial.

## Why the existing guard misses it

`isToolFanoutPath` (src/collectors/github.ts:293) only matches `(^|/)tools?/` or `.tools.ts`.
This repo keeps its 56 non-test tool files in `pkg/github/*.go`, so `toolFanoutCount` is `0`,
`detectSurfacePartial` (src/derive/schema.ts:1411) evaluates `0 > 0` as false, `surfacePartial`
stays false, and src/assemble.ts:226-228 publishes the sample count as complete.

The guard itself works — `grafana/mcp-grafana` keeps its tools under `tools/`, the guard fires,
and cost is correctly withheld. The detector is coupled to one directory convention rather than
to the thing it is trying to measure.

## Suggested direction

Make the partiality check independent of directory naming: after extraction, for each directory
that produced an extracted tool (`schema.tools[].evidence` already carries the source path),
compare how many source files that directory holds in the tree against how many were fetched.
Sampled < detected means `surfacePartial`.

## Why this is filed rather than fixed

**It moves published grades.** Servers currently graded would flip to withheld cost/security,
and some to INSUFFICIENT DATA through the `securityPrimaryAbsent` gate in score.ts — including
the A+ 96 in the README. It is not a rubric change (no weights, bands or `RUBRIC_VERSION`
touched), but the blast radius should be measured against `index/results.json` before landing,
and the README example probably needs choosing again afterwards.

That is a call for the maintainer, not something to slip in.

## Reproduction

```
node dist/assemble.js github/github-mcp-server
# => {"toolCount":4,"toolNames":["ui_get","get_me","get_teams","get_team_members"],
#     "toolSurfaceRisk":"low","schemaExtracted":true,"errors":[]}
```

Ground truth: grep for `Name: "..."` inside `mcp.Tool{}` literals under `pkg/github/*.go`.

Contrast: `grafana/mcp-grafana` in the same run returns `toolCount: undefined` with cost withheld.
